Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence queue (initial)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked very promising for our clinical data routing use case. Procurement asked me to get a formal response to the SIG questionnaire and a short list of artifacts we can expect to receive within two weeks. Key asks from our security team:

- A completed SIG questionnaire (we'll accept your annotated answers).
- Control-to-evidence crosswalk mapping (which artifact demonstrates each control).
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 bridge if Type II is not available for the requested period.
- Network diagram showing egress controls and third-party integrations.

Can you confirm timeline and a single point of contact for evidence uploads?

Cheers,
Tom

Thanks Jonas / Mina / Kimberly —

We have access to the Drive folder and the initial crosswalk looks good. A few quick clarifications from our security reviewer: 

- For A.2.1 please mark if customer-managed KMS is supported and include a short note on key separation (we need wording we can include in the contract).
- For C.3.4 the incident playbook reference is fine; can you also provide the PagerDuty escalation policy export or a redacted run (screenshot is fine) for evidence?
- Please confirm retention windows for audit logs (syslog / application logs) in the crosswalk (how long we keep full logs, indexes, and aggregated metrics).

If you can push the runbook screenshots and the retention table to the same Drive folder by EOD Friday we'll consider the SIG intake complete and move into contract review. Procurement: once we have those artifacts, we'll send our legal redlines.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Tom
